questions.stem: A 20-Year-old lady came to OPD on the second day of menstruation with excessive intolerable cramping pain. She has had similar complaints for 2 years and is taking over-the-counter drugs for pain relief. You gave antispasmodics and sent her to get an ultrasound to differentiate between primary and secondary dysmenorrhoea. Which of the following characters refers to primary dysmenorrhoea?

options.label: D
options.text: Reassurance, NSAIDs, analgesics, antispasmodics, and OC pills are the mainstay of treatment
